=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:3486 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The "Comment on issue failure" step treats STALL_FINGERPRINT_BREAKER_ENABLED as on only when it is exactly "true". The poller's is_truthy (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh) accepts 1|true|yes|on in any letter case.
  WHY: If an operator sets a truthy spelling such as "1", "yes" or "TRUE", the poller turns the breaker on, but the producer logs outcome=skipped reason=disabled and never appends AI_FAILURE_FINGERPRINT_V1, so _failure_fingerprint_breaker_check can never trip. All reviewers rated this NIT; the default 'true' is unaffected.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:2328 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: This has the same literal `!= "true"` check of STALL_FINGERPRINT_BREAKER_ENABLED as plan.yml, so it is out of step with the poller's is_truthy normalisation.
  WHY: With a truthy value other than lowercase "true", the clarify failure handler skips writing markers while the poller treats the breaker as enabled, so repeated identical failures keep looping on the stall ladder. All reviewers rated this NIT.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:3495-3497 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The failure-fingerprint handler uses the workflow job's `.id` as the check-run id when it requests annotations, instead of taking the id from `check_run_url`.
  WHY: If the job id and check-run id differ, the annotations request fails, the annotations file is removed and no marker is written (annotations_unavailable), so the breaker cannot trip. Both flagging reviewers rated this MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash examined it and did not raise it: an Actions job id equals its check-run id, and the step fails open. Sonnet listed it as a hardening suggestion only.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:2337-2339 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: clarify.yml makes the same use of the job `.id` as the check-run id for the annotations request as plan.yml.
  WHY: If the ids differ, the annotations lookup fails, the marker is omitted and the failure-fingerprint breaker cannot stop repeated failures. Both flagging reviewers rated this MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash examined it and declined to report it (same job/check-run id; fails open).
- scripts/ai_labels.py:261-273 (_drain_retired_label / _list_open_items_with_label / _retired_label_marker_present) with .github/workflows/sync_ai_labels.yml:43 (timeout-minutes: 5) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The retired-label drain makes many sequential GitHub API calls inside a 5-minute job and has no wall-clock budget of its own. Each call uses urlopen(timeout=120) with retries; z-ai_glm-5_3-flash estimates up to about 64 calls.
  WHY: A slow or rate-limited API can use up the job timeout mid-drain. The runner then kills the job before errors[] and LABEL_SYNC_RETIRED_DRAIN_DEFERRED are emitted. State stays safe (the label is not deleted), but diagnostics are lost and deletion can be starved indefinitely. All reviewers rated this NIT.
- PR-wide (PR description and diff size, ~920 KB, 108 files) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The PR is too large for the copilot-pull-request-reviewer check, which fails with "Prompt too big after adding system message".
  WHY: The automated review cannot process a diff this size, so the PR gets no machine-generated review from that check. Rated BLOCKER. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 noted the same failure (custom_instructions_too_large, 422) but judged it an external reviewer's prompt-size limit, not a defect in any changed file.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
